name: constraint-int64-bounds-past-2p53-pass
$comment: Int64 constraint bounds beyond 2^53 (IEEE-double exactness limit): the bound compare is EXACT i64 on the decimal string, never a float. Both seeds sit exactly on inclusive bounds far past 2^53 — one at min = 2^62 (4611686018427387904) and one at max = i64::MAX (9223372036854775807) — and must insert cleanly. A float-parsing engine (pre-fix ts/python) mis-handles the i64::MAX seed: float('9223372036854775807') rounds up to 2^63 and reads as above the max.
